title: Harnesses
review: One machine-local reconcile composes folder trust, Codex checkout/lane hook trust, unattended posture and machine hooks. Setup, install/refresh, lane preparation and doctor reuse it. Relay home-list changes trigger all registered checkout and lane targets without creating absent harness homes; facet refusals preserve files and teach recovery. Source tests prove late installation, byte-idempotence and backoff; receiving-harness proof remains a release check.
